name: Ling 3.0 Flash
short: InclusionAI's Aug 2026 MIT 124B/5.1B-active reasoning MoE (262K, 316 tok/s): GPQA 85.0%, LiveCodeBench 82.8%, SWE-bench Pro 56.6% at $0.075/$0.22.
pricingNote: $0.075/$0.22 per 1M (first-party API; some routes list $0.021/$0.063); MIT self-host $0
standout: Open-weight reasoning at 316 tok/s and a 44.1% hallucination rate - one of the cheapest capable MIT models.
tradeoff: Terminal-Bench 2.1 50-57% and Vibe Code Bench 2.9% show the agentic ceiling, and the same base now ships as Ling 3.1 Flash with a much stronger profile.
pricingTiers: Hosted $0.075/M in, $0.22/M out, $0.015/M cached read (first-party API); OpenRouter/Vercel list $0.021/$0.063
